title: should load the AI Observability module shell with secondary navigation
verifies: the AI Observability shell mounts its secondary section rail with the Experiments, Playground, and Datasets nav items

title: should load the Experiments page with header and New Experiment button
verifies: the Experiments page renders its header and the New Experiment button

title: should open the New Experiment create form from the Experiments page
verifies: clicking New Experiment navigates to and renders the experiment create form

title: should load the Datasets page with header and New Dataset button
verifies: the Datasets page renders its header and the New Dataset button

title: should open and dismiss the New Dataset create drawer
verifies: the New Dataset button opens the create drawer and the close button dismisses it

title: should load the Playground page with Run All button
verifies: the Playground page renders with its Run All button

title: should load the Quality page in the online evaluations section
verifies: the online evaluations Quality page renders
